skills.name: Special Beam Cannon
skills.description: Charges for 1 turn, visible to the enemy, then deals 40 Affliction Dmg (ignores invulnerability/defense/reduction) at the start of your next turn | 1 Eng, 1 Spt
skills.notes: Charges this turn (visible "CHARGING HIT" marker on the target, so the opponent sees it coming), then detonates automatically at the start of Piccolo's next turn -- a flat, unmitigated hit that ignores invulnerability/defense/reduction.
